units.source_text: 名人患病之后，间歇的四天更加成了负担。

en.t: After the Master fell ill, the four days between moves became even more of a burden.

units.source_text: 名人自不用说，就是这次棋赛的工作人员也都祈望早日结束这盘棋。

en.t: Needless to say, the Master himself hoped for it, and even the staff for this match were all praying that the game would end soon.

units.source_text: 这样不仅可以使名人舒畅些，工作人员也可以更放心。

en.t: That would not only make the Master feel a little easier, it would also let the staff feel more at ease.

units.source_text: 因为他们一直担心名人说不定什么时候会倒下去。

en.t: For they had been worried all along that the Master might collapse at any moment.
